functions.spark_sql: SELECT try_sum(i) AS sum_i, try_sum(CAST(p AS INT)) AS sum_p FROM bench WHERE id<8

SELECT 
try_sum(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('2147483647' AS BIGINT)
                WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-2147483648' AS BIGINT)
                WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE i END) AS bounded_sum,
try_sum(CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('2147483648' AS BIGINT)
                WHEN 1 THEN CAST('-2147483649' AS BIGINT)
                WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE i END) AS fallback_sum FROM bench WHERE id<8

SELECT try_sum(CASE id
    WHEN 0 THEN CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
    WHEN 1 THEN CAST(1 AS BIGINT)
    WHEN 2 THEN CAST(-1 AS BIGINT)
    ELSE CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
END) AS result FROM bench WHERE id<4

SELECT try_sum(CASE id
    WHEN 0 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT)
    WHEN 1 THEN CAST(-1 AS BIGINT)
    WHEN 2 THEN CAST(1 AS BIGINT)
    ELSE CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)
END) AS result FROM bench WHERE id<4
SELECT try_sum(CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)) AS result FROM bench WHERE id<8
SELECT try_sum(i) AS result FROM bench WHERE id<0
SELECT try_sum(dec) AS decimal_sum, try_sum(CAST(i AS DOUBLE)) AS double_sum FROM bench WHERE id<8
SELECT p, try_sum(DISTINCT i) AS distinct_sum, try_sum(i) FILTER (WHERE id % 3 = 0) AS filtered_sum FROM bench WHERE id<20000 GROUP BY p
SELECT id, try_sum(i) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM bench WHERE id<8
